q1.explanationZh: 前文说 Cicero 受萤火虫启发成了昆虫专家，所以他一生的工作是“研究”萤火虫，study 最合适。

evidence.quote: Cicero was inspired to become an insect expert

q2.explanationZh: 后文说现在只剩下很少几只，比当年少得多，说明萤火虫正在“消失”。

evidence.quote: Down to just a few compared to the big population they had back then.

q3.explanationZh: 前一句说美国和加拿大近三分之一的萤火虫可能灭绝，所以各地的数量都在“下降”，fall 表示下降。

evidence.quote: Nearly one in three firefly species in the United States and Canada may die out in the future

q4.explanationZh: 后文讲萤火虫的栖息地被破坏、被占用，所以最大的问题是栖息地的“丧失”。

evidence.quote: the Bethany Beach firefly’s sandy habitat is being squeezed to build beach homes

q5.explanationZh: 幼虫需要潮湿的土壤来“生长”，这些土壤却被破坏了。

evidence.quote: much of the wet soil that young fireflies need to

q6.explanationZh: 土地被用来盖房子、建球场，这些都是土地的“开发”。

evidence.quote: Instead, the land is used to build houses

q7.explanationZh: 栖息地被占，海平面又上升，所以它们“无处”可去，nowhere else 表示没有别的地方。

evidence.quote: Rising sea levels have made matters worse.

q8.explanationZh: 这句是说成年萤火虫只能“活”几周，live 表示存活。

evidence.quote: During this period, they have only one thing on their mind

q9.explanationZh: 萤火虫靠闪光找伴侣，人类夜里发出的“光”会让它们看不清对方。

evidence.quote: Others wait until midnight to turn on the lights.

q10.explanationZh: 灯光影响了萤火虫，所以想帮它们就要把灯“关掉”，turn off 是关闭。

evidence.quote: They provide us with much more than just a beautiful light show.
